top_signals.title: America's Refiners Drowned Their Own Gasoline Windfall
top_signals.summary: U.S. refiners spent 2026 squeezing less gasoline out of every barrel to chase diesel and jet fuel margins, and they still produced enough gasoline to nearly wipe out their margins on it. Gasoline yields averaged below 45% in the first eight months of the year and fell below the previous five-year low in every month, according to Energy Information Administration (EIA) data. Jet fuel's share of output topped 12% in March for the first time on record and stayed at or above that level through August. U.S. refiners also raised crude processing by 500,000…
